task: Phase C fixed calibrated Generic reference
fit: solve (X.T X + n*diag(0,1,1)) beta = X.T y

standardization.fit_on: training rows only per device and held-out architecture

folds: per device leave one entire classifier architecture out, train on other two
candidate_rule: paired native/generic positive finite FPS, numeric task quality pass, exact config/artifact binding, feature graph identity proved; same eligible candidate set for every method within cohort/group
quality_rule: numeric relative degradation (baseline_quality-native_quality)/baseline_quality <= 0.05; require finite positive baseline; cached policy flags are not numeric filter
feature_identity: use existing consistent graph operation prefix/total and logical boundary bytes definition only where mapping to measured exact graph is demonstrated; matching model/cut labels alone insufficient; unavailable otherwise
methods: fixed calibrated Generic descending predicted FPS
uniform random without replacement exact finite-set expectation
static rules only if feature formula and exact current graph identity are proved
budget_policy: report unavailable when k exceeds group n (no clamping, no detector k=5)
tie_policy: deterministic config_id ascending to break predicted score ties; all exactly maximal native values count as winners

metrics.native_regret: 100*(1-best measured native FPS among selected/native maximum)
metrics.winner_coverage: selected set contains at least one exact native winner
metrics.uniform_random: analytic finite combinatorial distribution of sample maximum; coverage=1-C(n-w,k)/C(n,k)

aggregation: equal weight complete model/setup groups separately for each cohort, task, method and k; report denominators/exclusions
inference: retrospective grouped validation; three architectures not generalization evidence; no cut-level significance tests
cost_accounting: k counts held-out native attempts only; measured Generic acquisition, native training, compilation and quality checks separately, no unmeasured total-cost savings claim
